cat > finish.py <<'PY'
import arena, subprocess,re
for i in range(65):
 b=arena.load_board()
 if arena.result(b):
  arena.show(b);break
 c=b.copy();h=[]
 while c.move_stack:c.pop();h.append(c.fen())
 open('history.txt','w').write('\n'.join(reversed(h)))
 s=subprocess.run(['./think',b.fen(),'15','history.txt'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
 print(s.splitlines()[-1],flush=True)
 u=re.findall('bestmove (\w+)',s)[-1]
 if __import__('chess').Move.from_uci(u) not in b.legal_moves:
  print('INVALID',flush=True);break
 arena.cmd_move(u)
 print('',flush=True)
